answer: Beacon-sharded capability lottery: agents commit sealed capability proofs each epoch; a threshold-BLS beacon seeds a VDF assigning identities to work shards and quotas. Like a garden with many inlet gates, no operator can whisper target assignments early, and commitments block grinding. A sybil must provision compute/bandwidth per identity and overprovision every shard because assignments are unpredictable; wasted capacity and epoch costs make mass identities uneconomic.
